'''Sector 5'''<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> was one of the twenty [[oversector]]s of the [[Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire]]. Sectors 1-6 made up the southern half of [[the galaxy]].<ref name="BMF 18">{{BuildFalconCite|18|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> The [[Tython system]] in the [[Deep Core]] was located in the oversector.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
